headlines.title: Simon Property Group Inc's Dividend Analysis
headlines.summary: Simon Property Group Inc (NYSE:SPG) recently announced a total dividend of $2.25 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-09.  This includes a $2.25 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-09-30.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.

headlines.title: Is Simon Property Stock Underperforming the Nasdaq?
headlines.summary: Simon Property has underperformed the Nasdaq over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

headlines.title: Nike, Simon Property Group dropped from S&P 100
headlines.summary: The shift, effective Sept. 21, is mostly symbolic, especially for the mall company. But for the apparel brand it’s a fresh reminder of ongoing struggles.

headlines.title: How Investors May Respond To Simon Property Group (SPG) Launching Its Simon Media Network Advertising Platform
headlines.summary: In August 2026, Simon Property Group launched Simon Media Network, a commerce media platform that lets brands reach high-intent shoppers across more than 200 Simon destinations using first-party consumer data and integrated digital, experiential, and online channels. This move turns Simon’s vast mall traffic and over US$100.00 billion in annual on-site commerce into a new advertising and insights business built on real-world consumer behavior signals.

headlines.title: Simon Launches Media Network to Unlock Value From Mall Traffic
headlines.summary: SPG launches a commerce media platform using its properties and consumer data to offer targeted, measurable advertising.

description: Simon Property Group, Inc. is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT). Simon Property Group, L.P., or the Operating Partnership, is our majority-owned partnership subsidiary that owns all of our real estate properties and other assets. In this package, the terms Simon, we, our, or the Company refer to Simon Property Group, Inc., the Operating Partnership, and its subsidiaries. We own, develop and manage premier shopping, dining, entertainment and mixed-use destinations, which consist primarily of malls, Premium Outlets, The Mills, and International Properties. At December 31, 2024, we owned or had an interest in 229 properties comprising 183 million square feet in North America, Asia and Europe. We also owned an 88% interest in The Taubman Realty Group, or TRG, which owns 22 regional, super-regional, and outlet malls in the U.S. and Asia. Additionally, at December 31, 2024, we had a 22.4% ownership interest in Klepierre, a publicly traded, Paris-based real estate company, which owns shopping centers in 14 European countries. Simon Property Group, Inc. was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Indianapolis, Indiana.
